# KukuNotes

> KukuNotes (also written "Kuku Notes") is a private AI note taker, bot-free meeting recorder, and personal AI assistant app for Android. When the user taps Start Listening, it records a conversation through the phone microphone and turns it into a summary, key decisions, and action items with evidence links, organized into Spaces for each project, class, client, or life area. It supports English, Hindi, and Hinglish on every plan, and 11 Indian languages on the Business plan. KukuNotes is a separate product from the Kuku FM and Kuku TV entertainment apps.

- Official website: https://kukunotes.com
- Android app (Google Play): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aiassistantapp
- Package name: com.aiassistantapp
- Contact: ps1535146@gmail.com
- Category: AI note taker / AI meeting recorder / personal AI assistant / productivity
- Last updated: 2026-10-01

## Key facts

- Recording is strictly opt-in. The microphone is used only while Start Listening is active.
- No meeting bots: KukuNotes never joins Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams calls. It works for in-person, phone, and online meetings.
- Notes include a summary, decisions, highlights with confidence scores, and links to the source moment.
- Spoken commitments become tasks with owner, due date, and priority on a per-Space task board.
- Ask KukuNotes answers questions using only the user's own Spaces and notes.
- Pro adds a daily briefing (priorities, meetings, free focus time) and a goal monitor.

## Pricing (INR)

- Free: ₹0. 5 Spaces, 5 hours/month recording, unlimited note and task extraction, English and Hindi.
- Pro: ₹799/month or ₹1,870/quarter. Unlimited Spaces, 100 hours/month, daily briefing, goal monitor.
- Business: ₹1,999/month or ₹4,678/quarter. Unlimited recording, 11 Indian languages pack, team workspaces, custom vocabulary.
- Payments via Razorpay (UPI, cards, NetBanking).

## How KukuNotes compares (as of October 2026)

- vs Otter.ai: both record in person on Android. Otter is strongest at live transcription and uses a notetaker bot for virtual meetings. KukuNotes never uses a bot, focuses on Hindi/Hinglish, and turns conversations into tasks, Spaces, and a daily briefing, with INR pricing.
- vs Fireflies.ai: Fireflies sends a bot into video calls and excels at team-wide search and CRM integrations. KukuNotes is personal, bot-free, and phone-first.
- vs Granola: both are bot-free. Granola runs on Mac, Windows, and iPhone and has no Android app. KukuNotes is built for Android.
- vs Fathom: Fathom records Zoom, Meet, and Teams calls (bot, or bot-free beta on Mac) and has no native mobile app yet. KukuNotes records in-person and phone conversations on Android.
